title: Anna Blue | KEY.co
description_expanded: Set within the desirable Crossing District of WaterColor, this stunning three-level retreat blends refined coastal style with spacious comfort designed for memorable group getaways. Thoughtfully designed with five bedrooms and five-and-a-half bathrooms, the home welcomes with warm wood flooring, a beautifully styled living area, and a chef-inspired kitchen ideal for everything from relaxed breakfasts to elegant evening gatherings. A private king suite on the main level offers a peaceful escape, while the second floor features two additional king suites and a luxurious primary suite with a private balcony overlooking the pool—perfect for quiet mornings or sunset relaxation. The top level creates the ultimate gathering space with four queen beds and a comfortable lounge featuring foosball and plush seating for movie nights and family fun. Outdoors, a private pool anchors a serene entertaining area made for soaking up the Florida sunshine, with optional pool heating for year-round enjoyment. Six adult bikes and a six-seater golf cart make exploring effortless, while access to WaterColor’s renowned amenities—including pools, trails, and beach access—adds another layer of convenience and luxury. With its perfect balance of upscale design and laid-back coastal charm, this home offers an exceptional setting for a truly unforgettable stay.

Features: Guests assume all risk for use of pools
